protocol.name: D11 fixed-expert task-free latent-router pilot
protocol.purpose: test whether separate task-free routing can recover the useful alternative response curves already generated by D10
protocol.scope: the same 218 fit groups and five episode-blocked folds; D10 curve experts are frozen; prior inspected TRAIN, DEV, and TEST remain closed

data.assignment: within each training fold only, choose the frozen D10 component with minimum complete 6-by-41 task-free curve MSE
data.event_normalization: fit continuous transition-delta and executed-control scales on each non-validation training fold only

frozen_experts.checkpoint_rule: use the exact seed-1 D10 checkpoint and normalizers for the matching fold

arms.snapshot_router: mean and maximum pooling over frozen D10 six-level pair features, followed by a small MLP
arms.event_router: the same snapshot features plus shared encoding and mean, maximum, and latest pooling of explicit generic transition events
arms.event_channels: signed and absolute continuous-state change, contacts before/after, contact creation/loss, and executed control

optimization.loss: unweighted cross entropy on training-fold likelihood assignments
optimization.execution: one sequential GPU run at a time

decision.pass: replicate each passing router with seeds 2 and 3 before any untouched split is opened
decision.fail: stop fitting architectures to these 218 groups and collect broader task-independent interaction-response data before visual transfer
